fusions.name: One Clean Pass
fusions.desc: Throws a needle on a line at a target up to 8 tiles away that deals 28 damage, rising to 2 times that at full range. It is always a critical hit and leaves the target [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Seam Ripper
fusions.desc: Runs a strand through a gap in the target's armour. It deals 7 damage and leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds. It holds 4 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Pattern Shared
fusions.desc: Ties a strand to every ally within 5 tiles. Each of them strikes 15% harder and fights with 1 more power for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Backstitch
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, the strand whips on to the nearest enemy within 5 tiles and deals 6 damage, then leaps to 1 more enemy within 3 tiles for 50% of that. Once every 5 seconds.
